image_description: Two small Blenheim spaniel puppies sitting on a ground covered in dry brown leaves. The puppy on the left is facing forward with its head turned slightly to the right, showing a white face with brown patches around the eyes and ears. The puppy on the right is curled up, facing away from the camera, with its head down among the leaves, displaying a white body with large brown patches.

This is common in AI generation but could also be depth-of-field blur. It lacks the sharp 'cut-out' look of severe artifacts but isn't perfectly crisp.

The right puppy's head is tucked down, and the facial features are indistinct and somewhat 'melted' into the fur/leaves. While this could be a natural pose, the lack of distinct nose/mouth definition suggests minor structural ambiguity common in AI generations of occluded faces.
